# Iceland — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Where is Iceland?", "N. Atlantic"),
    ("What is notable about Iceland?", "Volcanic island nation"),
    ("What is location?", "N. Atlantic"),
    ("What is key stat?", "103,000 km²"),
    ("What is notable fact?", "Volcanic island nation"),
    ("What is note?", "Geysers, glaciers, Vikings"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
